verdict.rationale: Greenhouse offers a Harvest API that covers many core recruiting actions (update candidates, add attachments, advance/move/reject applications, retrieve stages) plus Job Board API and webhooks, suggesting broad but not exhaustive API parity with the UI. However, newer AI-native features (Voice AI, Notetaker, Talent Matching/Real Talent, Offer Forecast, bulk outreach) are described only as UI/product features with no documented API endpoints, and probes for OpenAPI spec/llms.txt all 404, indicating no machine-readable full API surface. Missing for 10: API coverage for AI features (Notetaker, Voice AI, Talent Matching), a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and independent confirmation of full UI-API parity.
